name: Imperial Rifleman's [Class Bonus] On Enter: becomes distant
notes: The On Enter trigger only fires on a real materialize (BridgeAddToZone seeds silently, no Enter trigger), so it must be played from hand while a RANGER Class Bonus is already active. Seeds a RANGER champion (Diana, Keen Huntress) onto player 1's field, then plays Imperial Rifleman from a known hand slot on turn 1 (materializing doesn't hit Rule 1.h's attack lock, so no turn-cycle is needed here). Its 3-reserve cost needs 3 reps of the myHand-0 reserve-payment decision (MZCHOOSE=myHand), matching its printed cost.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Enter: Imperial Rifleman becomes distant. (Units stay distant until the end of their controller's turn. Apply this effect only if your champion's class matches this card's class.)
